panel.engine_note: Q04 采集器逐字复制；面板指纹断言对齐 Q04

device.roll: greedy self-rollout: ctx0 = P0 token ids; 每步读 last-position 6 类 logit; k<K 时 apped argmax(logits_last) 回喂
device.margin: logit(t_target) - logit(t_competitor); t_target = 该类首 token; t_competitor = k=0 处 logit 最高的非该类类首 token（每 cell 冻结）
device.normalization: none (frozen formula is raw L1); secondary relative scale reported only
device.aggregation: per seed: mean over held-out rows; then mean over 3 seeds

precision.policy: 4-bit NF4（bnb_4bit_quant_type=nf4, double_quant=True, compute_dtype=bf16）；14B/9B 因 16 GB 显存无法 bf16 常驻而采用——与 E_read 的 bf16 存在量化差
precision.declare: nf4 引入与 E_read bf16 的量化差；由 D4 精度桥约束其可用性

gates.D0: collector equivalence: SMOKE+bf16+qwen3-4b 时逐位复现 Q04 SMOKE 的 E_ar(k)
gates.D1: k=0 determinism: two passes bit-identical on 6-class logits
